description: No first-order formula in the one-relation language defines finite reachability uniformly in every nonempty relation structure and at every pair of elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.reachability_not_definable :
  ¬∃ ρ,
      ∀ (M : Type) (x : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.language.Structure M),
        Nonempty M →
          ∀ (a b : M),
            ρ.Realize ![a, b] ↔
              Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.Reachable Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ExpressiveLimits.edge a b
